name: Minori
source:
The ace of the volleyball team. She is tall and beautiful, with an enticing body. She is not interested in men or fashion, and is devoted to volleyball. She is unaware her body is attractive to men. 

She is shy, but secretly wants to be spoiled by girls like Kirari. She finds out about Kirari's relationship with the MC and tries to break them up.
